name: Air Canada Rouge (2017 refresh)
description: White fuselage; the aft fuselage red from a line rising from the belly ahead of the aft door to the fin root, crossed by a white diagonal stripe; 'AIR CANADA' small in red capitals with the roundel, and 'rouge' large in dark-red script lower case over the forward windows; the fin white with a red tip and a large red disc carrying a white maple leaf; red engines and winglets.

areas.name: red aft fuselage and tail cone
white diagonal stripe across the red, from the fin root down and back

logos.description: Rouge's tail: a huge red disc, its center low and aft of the fin so the fin's edges crop it to a curved red field over the lower two thirds, with a big white maple leaf on it tilted forward, its top point at the disc's edge. Mirrored on the right (C-FYJH).
The small Air Canada roundel in red ahead of 'AIR CANADA'.

titles.style: Small, widely spaced red capitals above 'rouge'.
'rouge' in a large, informal, brush-like script lower case in dark red over the forward windows, the g's tail dropping well below.

notes: Drawn from C-GKFB (A321, Oct 2025). The fin's disc and leaf are simplified; the leaf's exact shape is in the logo entry's reference. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on C-GKFB: 'rouge' runs x 0.141 to 0.264, its lowercase from y 0.065 (just under the windows) to 0.39; it has no capitals or ascenders, so its height is the lowercase's and xHeight is 1 (it had been drawn 0.53 tall). The red's front edge re-measured: a convex curve from the belly about x 0.67 (a long thin sliver along the belly) up through the window line ahead of the aft door (x 0.80; it had been drawn behind the door) to the fin's root; it and the white stripe are smooth, the stripe's square top kept as corners.
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximate standard (a few colors from memory). The current scheme refreshed Rouge's 2013 launch livery; the year (2017) is from memory.
